title: For carcinogenic molecules containing triple bonds, identify which element
question: For carcinogenic molecules containing triple bonds, identify which element (among nitrogen, sulfur, and phosphorus) appears most frequently in these molecules. Calculate the average number of bonds per atom for this most frequent element.

prediction.sql:
WITH carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
element_frequencies AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element,
           COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS freq
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules ctbm ON a.XCL_002 = ctbm.XCL_010
    WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('n', 's', 'p')
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM element_frequencies
    ORDER BY freq DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
atoms_of_most_frequent AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001 AS atom_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules ctbm ON a.XCL_002 = ctbm.XCL_010
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = (SELECT element FROM most_frequent_element)
),
bond_counts_per_atom AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id,
           COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS bond_count
    FROM atoms_of_most_frequent a
    INNER JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
)
SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM bond_counts_per_atom

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic'
),
triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'triple'
),
target_molecules AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules tbm ON cm.molecule_id = tbm.molecule_id
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.molecule_id
    WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('nitrogen', 'sulfur', 'phosphorus')
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bonds_per_atom AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS total_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS total_atoms
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008 OR a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
    WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('nitrogen', 'sulfur', 'phosphorus')
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
)
SELECT 
    bpa.total_bonds * 1.0 / bpa.total_atoms AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM bonds_per_atom bpa
INNER JOIN most_frequent_element mfe ON bpa.element = mfe.element
